repo_notes.content: Please document the language GMBASIC that I am building in Gamemaker and not the Gamemaker project itself

pages.title: Overview
pages.purpose: What GMBASIC is: a BASIC dialect interpreter and retro terminal built in GameMaker. It is being made as a hobby project to make my own version of BASIC that has some GML features!

pages.title: The BASIC Language and Interpreter
pages.purpose: Overview of the SCRIPT interpreter pipeline: lines -> tokens -> execution; links to tokenizer, expressions, and command reference pages.

pages.title: Tokenizer and Expression Evaluation
pages.purpose: TOKEN kinds, tokenize(), shunting-yard to_postfix(), evaluate_postfix(), operator precedence, variable lookup via get_variable.

pages.title: Command Reference
pages.purpose: BASIC statements supported: PRINT, LET, IF/THEN/ELSE, GOTO, INPUT, END, CLS and graphics commands (LINE, RECT, FRECT, TRI, FTRI, CIRC, FCIRC, SETDRAWCOLOR, ).

pages.title: Graphics Command Buffer
pages.purpose: How graphics_build is accumulated and swapped on CLS, and how the draw event consumes the graphics array to render primitives.

pages.title: The Terminal System (objSystem)
pages.purpose: Overview of the objSystem controller: its events, state variables and role as the REPL/editor shell; links to child pages.

pages.title: Initialization and State
pages.purpose: Create event: state flags (running, viewing, on), buffers, surfaces, cursor blink call_later, prefs.ini loading, row_length metrics.

pages.title: Input Handling and Immediate Commands
pages.purpose: Step event: keyboard polling, line editing, INPUT waiting state, and immediate commands DEL/RUN/RESTART/CLS/NEW/UPLOAD/PASTE/SAVE/LOAD/COLOR/BACKGROUND.

pages.title: Rendering Pipeline
pages.purpose: Draw GUI event: back_buffer surface, graphics interpretation, 80-column output wrapping, prompt + cursor, scissor-clipped code pane, variable inspector.

pages.title: Function Keys and Built-in Demo Programs
pages.purpose: F1 Manual, F2 screen_saver, F3 debug, F4 LudusDemo load, F5 run, TAB view toggle, PgUp/PgDn scrolling, and back_task save/restore of the user program.

pages.title: Notifications (objSystemNotification)
pages.purpose: notify() helper and the transient on-screen notification object: create/step timer/draw lifecycle.

pages.title: Program I/O and Persistence
pages.purpose: Overview of how BASIC programs and settings enter and leave the system; links to loaders and settings pages.

pages.title: Loading and Uploading BASIC Source
pages.purpose: upload_basic, load_basic, load_basic_from_string, load_basic_from_clipboard in Script5; SAVE/LOAD JSON buffer serialization of PROGRAM.bas.

pages.title: Bundled Demo Program (LudusDemo.bas)
pages.purpose: Walkthrough of datafiles/LudusDemo.bas as a worked example of INPUT, LET, graphics, and GOTO-based animation loops.

pages.title: Settings and Theming (prefs.ini)
pages.purpose: COLOR/BACKGROUND commands, supported color tokens, persistence to prefs.ini SETTINGS section and reload at startup.

pages.title: Assets and Build Configuration
pages.purpose: Overview of non-code resources and per-platform export options; links to child pages.

pages.title: Fonts and Sprites
pages.purpose: fntDejaVuSansMono monospaced font (incl. .old variants) used for terminal text metrics, and sprPalette color palette sprite.

pages.title: Room and Platform Export Options
pages.purpose: rmConsole room setup and the options/ directory: windows, html5, linux, mac, ios, android, tvos, operagx, reddit, main.

pages.title: Glossary
pages.purpose: Definitions of GMBASIC and GameMaker-specific terms with code pointers: SCRIPT, TOKEN, tokenize, to_postfix, evaluate_postfix, objSystem, objSystemNotification, typed_text, program_text, back_task, graphics_build, back_buffer, game_surface, row_length, viewing/running/on, prefs.ini, immediate command, line number, rmConsole, .yy/.yyp, draw GUI event, scissor pane, notify, SETDRAWCOLOR.
